title: Fat Parrots
description: This pack makes parrots very fat.
body:
![Fat parrots](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/27748d8bd28e7bcfa6f5a3a11bb8f9bdf404a5cf.png)



This resource pack makes parrots very fat. They are very heavy now, you _will_ 100% get tired of having these dudes on your shoulder. But they are still cute though, enjoy dealing with these chunky birdies!

**Dependencies:
[EMF] Entity Model Features
[ETF] Entity Texture Features**
